title: Charge type identification
description: Essential: Student must correctly identify that both fixed spheres at B and C carry positive charge.

title: Geometry recognition
description: Important: Student must recognize the right triangle ABC and correctly apply the Pythagorean theorem or trigonometric relations (e.g., sin∠ABC = AC/BC = 1/2, ∠ABC = 30°).

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: Student must resolve forces on sphere A into components (e.g., along directions perpendicular to AB and AC) and set up equilibrium equations using Coulomb's law and gravity.

title: Final charge magnitudes
description: Essential: Student must correctly solve for the charges, obtaining Q_B = 3mgd²/(8kq) and Q_C = √3 mgd²/(8kq).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns negative charges to B or C, or misaligns force directions in the equilibrium equations.

title: Trigonometric mistake
description: Pitfall: Student makes an error in the angles (e.g., misidentifying 30° or 60°) or in the corresponding sine/cosine values in the force components.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student explicitly checks or states that the final expressions have correct units for charge.
